kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نجتمع (form VIII)
# نَجْتَمِعُ (najtamiʕu) /nad͡ʒ.ta.mi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَمَعَ (ijtamaʕa)
# نَجْتَمِعَ (najtamiʕa) /nad͡ʒ.ta.mi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَمَعَ (ijtamaʕa)
# نَجْتَمِعْ (najtamiʕ) /nad͡ʒ.ta.miʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِجْتَمَعَ (ijtamaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
